patch_description: Replace the simulated-annealing architecture with a smooth-optimization pipeline: (1) parameterize points on the unit sphere, (2) maximize a differentiable soft-min/soft-max distance ratio using Adam with temperature annealing (softmin/softmax gradients are exact and vectorized), (3) polish the best candidate with a short coordinate-perturbation local search and small-scale multi-start restarts. This changes data flow from stochastic single-point moves to full-batch gradient ascent with a structured restart pool, giving faster and more reliable convergence toward the optimal 14-point ratio.
